name: Broiled Chicken Thighs over Creamy Zucchini-Cauliflower Rice
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower and transfer to a large bowl.
Trim and coarsely grate zucchini; add to the bowl with the cauliflower and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan.
Drizzle chicken with oil and season with spices on both sides; spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping the chicken halfway through, until golden brown and cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower, zucchini, cream, and spices to the pan; cook, stirring often, until veggies are soft, 6-8 minutes.
Add Parmesan, chives, and additional cream to the pan with the veggies. Reduce heat to medium and continue to cook, stirring often, until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide chicken and creamy zucchini-cauliflower rice between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
